question: Amitabh Bachchan had been selected for the Dada Saheb Phalke award for the year ____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2018**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amitabh Bachchan**, often referred to as the "Shahenshah of Bollywood," was selected for the prestigious **Dada Saheb Phalke Award** in the year **2018**.
 
• The **Dada Saheb Phalke Award** is considered India's highest award in the field of cinema. It is conferred by the Government of India for outstanding contribution to the growth and development of Indian cinema.
 
• Amitabh Bachchan received the award in recognition of his **immense contribution to Indian cinema** over a career spanning several decades.
 
• The award was officially announced by the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting in **September 2019**, and he was honored during the **National Film Awards ceremony**.
 
• The Dada Saheb Phalke Award includes a **Swarna Kamal (Golden Lotus)**, a shawl, and a cash prize of **10 lakh rupees**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dada Saheb Phalke Award:**

 
 
• Named after **Dadasaheb Phalke**, the "Father of Indian Cinema," who directed India's first full-length feature film, **Raja Harishchandra**, in 1913.
 
• First awarded in **1969**, the inaugural recipient was **Devika Rani**, known as the "First Lady of Indian Cinema."
 
• The award is given annually at the National Film Awards ceremony by the Directorate of Film Festivals, under the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting.
 
• Recipients are chosen based on their significant contribution to the art of cinema, spanning acting, direction, production, writing, and music, among others.
 
 
 
• **Amitabh Bachchan's Legacy:**
 
 
• Amitabh Bachchan, born on **October 11, 1942**, is one of the most influential and iconic actors in Indian cinema.
 
• He gained popularity in the 1970s with films like **Zanjeer**, **Deewar**, and **Sholay**, earning him the title "Angry Young Man."
 
• Over his career, he has acted in more than **200 films** and won numerous accolades, including **4 National Film Awards** and multiple **Filmfare Awards**.
 
• In addition to acting, he has worked as a playback singer, television host, and producer, and he remains an influential figure in Indian culture.
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Recipients of the Dada Saheb Phalke Award:**
 
 
• **Raj Kapoor** (1987): Renowned actor and filmmaker known for his contributions to Indian cinema's golden era.
 
• **Lata Mangeshkar** (1989): The "Nightingale of India," famous for her unparalleled contribution to Indian music.
 
• **Yash Chopra** (2001): Legendary filmmaker known for romantic hits like **Dil To Pagal Hai** and **Veer-Zaara**.
 
• **Rajinikanth** (2019): Superstar of Tamil cinema with a massive fan following across India and overseas.
 
 
 
• **Important Points:**
 
 
• The **Ministry of Information and Broadcasting** oversees the selection process for the Dada Saheb Phalke Award.
 
• The award honors individuals who have made a lasting impact on Indian cinema and its global recognition.
 
• It is not limited to actors and directors but also includes individuals from other film-related fields like cinematography, music, and screenwriting.
 
• The recognition serves as a testament to the recipient's lifelong dedication to the Indian film industry.
